name: Meteor Shower AP

stealth.note: @Check[Astronomy Lore|dc:41] (master) or @Check[nature|dc:45] (legendary) to notice signs of the approach of unusual celestial bodies

description: Impact from a sufficiently large asteroid would be powerful enough to wipe out a region or destroy a planet, but smaller-scale impact events, like from a meteor shower, present hazards that could be survived. This shower might arise naturally, or it might be the result of the PCs or other forces preventing a greater calamity by breaking a world-rending asteroid into smaller pieces.
disable: Astronomy Lore|dc:40 (master) or DC 50 Nature (legendary) to predict the trajectory of the falling asteroids and determine safe zones, DC 45 Athletics (legendary) or DC 47 Crafting (master) to dig underground shelters, DC 45 Diplomacy (master) or DC 47 Intimidation (master) to coordinate an orderly evacuation
routine: (1+ minutes, Basic DC 17 Flat ) Small asteroids rain down across the sky, battering and incinerating those caught in their path before carving craters. Over the course of a minute, enough asteroids smash into the ground and explode to inflict 6d10 Bludgeoning Damage|options:area-damage] damage to any unprepared characters in the area (Basic DC 44 Reflex Saving Throw save). The 40-foot-radius craters left behind are greater difficult terrain.
